items.title: Goldman Hikes Oil-Price Forecasts on ‘Substantial’ Supply Risks
items.description: Goldman Sachs Group Inc. raised oil-price forecasts for the year-end and 2027 on elevated risks to supplies, joining other banks in hiking their outlooks after months of war in the Middle East.

items.description: Software services exporters claim all five top spots in the large-cap index in October.

items.title: PBOC Conducts Overnight Reverse Repo as Policy Anchor Shifts
items.description: China’s central bank launched daily overnight reverse repurchase operations on Monday, kicking off a revamped liquidity framework that establishes the short-term tool as its primary policy anchor.

items.title: Foreigners Make Record Withdrawal From Taiwan Stocks on AI Rout
items.description: Foreign outflows from Taiwanese stocks hit a record in October as a global selloff in artificial intelligence play pushed the island’s benchmark closer to a technical correction.

items.title: Japanese Stocks Fall on Tech Selloff, Kioxia’s Profit Outlook
items.description: Japanese stocks fell, with technology shares taking a hit from a steep selloff in their US peers, while chipmaker Kioxia Holdings Corp. slumped after a disappointing profit outlook.

items.title: Gold Climbs Back From One-Year Low as Dip Buyers Arrest Slide
items.description: Gold rose, as lower oil prices offered some respite from inflationary pressures and dip buyers were drawn by the metal’s slide Friday to the lowest in a year.
